categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Develop Advanced Manufacturing Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of specialized oil and gas equipment components. Its main product categories include oil and gas production system components, well control device components, and unconventional oil and gas extraction components. The company also serves other industries such as engineering machinery, mining machinery, and nuclear power components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies including microalloying, deep-sea oil and gas equipment manufacturing, hot extrusion forming, precision forming, heat treatment, ultrasonic phased array testing, and computer-aided process development. It has developed integrated material and manufacturing process technologies and maintains strict adherence to API international standards. The company also utilizes a one-stop shop model from forging materials to final component assembly.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major international oil and gas technology service companies such as TechnipFMC, Schlumberger (SLB), Baker Hughes, and Caterpillar. The company’s products are used globally in offshore and onshore oil and gas extraction, including deep-sea drilling, shale gas fracturing, and high-pressure fluid transport. It also supplies domestic shale gas fracturing equipment manufacturers like Jerry Group and Sany Petroleum.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant international sales covering regions including Brazil, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK, Romania, France, and Argentina. It has subsidiaries in Singapore and maintains a global supply chain and customer base, especially in the Asia-Pacific region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Develop operates primarily in the midstream manufacturing segment of the oil and gas equipment supply chain. It manufactures specialized components for oilfield equipment used by oilfield service companies and integrates upstream material processing with downstream assembly and testing, extending its industrial chain to provide one-stop manufacturing services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-value-added products for deep-sea and fracturing oil and gas equipment, investing heavily in R&D for materials, manufacturing processes, and product testing technologies. It pursues international certification and collaboration with global oilfield service companies, aiming to enhance product quality and expand into other high-end equipment sectors such as aerospace and nuclear power. Key R&D projects include multi-directional forging, ultrasonic phased array testing, and nickel-based alloy welding technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized oil and gas equipment components to large oilfield service companies and equipment manufacturers. Sales are conducted via negotiated contracts and bidding, including long-term framework agreements and spot orders. The company recognizes revenue upon delivery and customer acceptance, with export sales accounting for a significant portion of total revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading supplier of specialized oil and gas equipment components in China and a key Asia-Pacific supplier to major global oilfield service companies. It competes with international and domestic manufacturers certified under API standards. Its competitive advantages include advanced manufacturing technologies, high product quality, and strong strategic partnerships with industry leaders, positioning it prominently in the global deep-sea oil and gas equipment market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, a 7.12% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 85.6 million, down 39.9%. Total assets reached RMB 2.76 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.79 billion. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 3.46% of revenue. Despite short-term revenue decline due to market conditions, the company maintains stable order levels and is expanding capacity through strategic investments and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Develop emphasizes high reliability, high pressure resistance, and strong corrosion resistance of its products, tailored for complex and harsh oil and gas extraction environments, especially deep-sea applications. It offers integrated manufacturing solutions with strict adherence to international standards and customization capabilities. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, advanced production technologies, and close collaboration with global oilfield service companies differentiate it as a trusted supplier in the high-end oil and gas equipment component market.
